name: palette
about: Open the palette, search, close it. Starts from an open console and leaves it open.
gaps: ducktape-views@a2a73e1 palette — there are no commands: the palette only searches messages and pages, so "run a command" cannot be walked
ducktape-views@a2a73e1 palette/src/lib.rs:141-146 — hit rows are unnamed buttons: a hit cannot be chosen by name
ducktape-views@a2a73e1 palette — the field is not focused when the palette opens: a keyboard user must move focus to it first

ducktape-views@a2a73e1 palette/src/presentation.rs:29-55 — no Close button: the scrim that closes it is an unnamed button that the door's tree does not show, and Escape does not close it (a Stack, not an Overlay with a dismiss); a pointer user closes it only by pressing Search again, a keyboard user by the chord again (FINDINGS-2026-09-19 P1)

steps.expect: the palette opens: a Search messages and pages field shows

steps.say: type qa walk into the Search messages and pages field
steps.expect: the palette answers: hit rows show, or a note such as 'No messages or pages matched.' (Searching… is a state, not an error)

steps.say: press Search in the rail again to close the palette
steps.expect: the Search messages and pages field is gone
